statement: For the exact linear selected-triangle edge union on17 points with selected degrees3 at two adjacent centers and2 elsewhere, with each edge already having one internal common neighbor, K=H+4I is positive definite. Every independent binary type of size<=7 containing at most one center obeys q(t)<=(|t|+number_of_centers_in_t)/2<=4, strictly in the first inequality for nonempty t; hence the single-type lower-Gram Schur inequality excludes none of these types.

q=t^T(H+4I)^-1t over the reals; empty t retained
